newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trade quiet, bids at $70-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trade quiet, bids at $70-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday remained quiet, with no sales of slaughter steers or heifers reported, feedlot sources said.
Bids Friday were scattered at $70.00, with asking prices also light at $72.00.
Most feedlots reportedly were current in their marketings following this week's active sales at $71.00 per cwt. The trades were down $2.00 from last week's top prices.
Cattle next week were expected to be priced at $72.00, but will most likely trade at $71.00, some sources said.
